Ship space: forward -Z, right +X, up +Y. mass kg; inertia kg m² about pitch (x), yaw (y), roll (z), here a 2 t box 4.6 x 3.2 x 8.3 m (the greybox hull); thrust N per direction in vacuum, all thrusters pushing that way together (here 60/40/24/50/30 m/s² on 2 t); torque N m per axis (yaw the weak axis: 6 rad/s² against 8 for pitch); cargo_point m, ship space: the cabin floor's centre, where locked cargo weighs (its mass and the inertia it adds, #88).
